# Get Value For Key

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Get's the value for a certain key in a dictionary.

## Syntax

~~~~text
valueFor(key: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, dictionary: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
valueFor(key: "\", dictionary: )
~~~~
